name: xoga713-var-accounting-table-load-2
description: Second load of opera.var_accounting_table from legacy MySQL. Run AFTER xoga713-var-accounting-rmc-reset.json. Step rmc: RMC again, now with delta1/gamma1/vega1 (the live legacy rmc views have them; the first load wrote NULL). Step new-bus: the business units the 2025 DDL dump did not list (alm, coc, cof, oad, odr, spc, frt). Insert only.
